methods.description: Count cubes in one rectangular layer and multiply by the layers, using cm³ or m³.
Use all three equal cube dimensions and distinguish cubic volume from area.
Put every dimension in the same length unit before multiplying.
Use the cubes per layer and division to find a missing whole-number height; check the product.
Record volume with cubic units and diagnose area or length unit errors.
